accelerator_shape: two physical Tesla T4s required; fail closed unless inventory confirms both

budget.provider_quota_gate: latest typed provider remaining must cover 7h max reservation plus any separately stated provider reserve
budget.root_ledger_gate: latest root ledger cumulative +14 planned +6 recovery <=80

fit_protocol: Two concurrent full fits, bind each fit to the UUID used by its passing probe; fixed epoch 3, no in-fit evaluation or best-epoch selection; score only after both complete
full_hashing: Strict initial archive hash plus full code/input hash in each controller phase and worker; no receipt cache/reuse
probe_protocol: Always execute both fresh production-shape one-batch probes, parse FIT records and require one batch, positive optimizer completion, zero AMP skip, matching EMA count, measured memory within caps; start neither full fit unless both pass
push_command_shape: kaggle kernels push --path <private-kernel-push-dir> --timeout 25200; keep exact source, private metadata, GPU enabled, internet/TPU disabled
required_before_push: root review of archive/kernel/manifest/source diff and watchdog
private dataset upload and READY inventory verification for all expanded files
fresh typed provider-quota snapshot and root device-hour ledger admission
